never_auto.RF_transmission: Default RX-only. TX requires country + frequency + PHY + power + antenna + regulatory-pass.
never_auto.calibration: Default DO NOT MODIFY. Per-unit; would require factory re-probe.
never_auto.eFuses: Default DO NOT MODIFY. Requires explicit operator approval + reason + audit entry.
never_auto.identity_region: Default DO NOT MODIFY unless this is the workflow's explicit purpose.
never_auto.permanent_security: Default DO NOT MODIFY. Once set, often not reversible.
never_auto.private_keys: Default DO NOT MODIFY. Use per-device key provisioning, not firmware-baked.
